business_model.claim: Titan America is a vertically integrated maker and supplier of heavy building materials, operating mainly in Florida and the Mid-Atlantic, including Metro New York, Virginia and the Carolinas.
quotes: Titan America is a leading vertically integrated, multi-regional manufacturer and supplier of heavy building materials and services operating primarily in Florida, the New York and New Jersey Metropolitan area (“Metro New York”), Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina (Virginia and the Carolinas, together with Metro New York and their adjacent areas, the “Mid-Atlantic”).

business_model.claim: Almost all revenue comes from selling five product lines: cement, fly ash, aggregates, ready-mix concrete and concrete block.
quotes: Substantially all of the Company’s revenue is derived from sales of cement, fly ash, aggregates, ready-mix concrete and concrete block.

quotes: Due to the regional nature of our business, we report our operating results in two reportable segments: Florida and Mid-Atlantic.

business_model.claim: The asset base includes two cement plants, three marine import terminals, 82 ready-mix locations and 22 distribution hubs.
quotes: We operate and maintain two cement plants, three multi-product marine import terminals, seven active mine locations, 82 ready-mix locations with 96 batch plants, eight concrete block locations with 13 production lines, seven fly ash plants and 22 distribution hubs that can handle various combinations of our products.

business_model.claim: The two cement plants have current capacity of 2.4 million tons at Pennsuco in Florida and 1.5 million tons at Roanoke in Virginia, with expansions planned by 2030.
quotes: Our Pennsuco plant currently has a cement production capacity of 2.4 million tons, which, through ongoing focused and strategic investments, we expect will increase to over 2.9 million tons by 2030.
Our Roanoke Plant’s current cement production capacity is 1.5 million tons, and investment is underway with the goal of increasing production capacity to 1.8 million tons by 2030.

business_model.claim: Imported cement adds to own production. The Port Tampa Bay Terminal has averaged over 750,000 tons of imported cement a year.
quotes: Our Port Tampa Bay Terminal has also averaged over 750,000 tons of imported cement annually over the last three years, with an ability to manage approximately 2.5 million tons of cement annually.

business_model.claim: Vertical integration means internally produced cement and aggregates supply the company's own ready-mix and block operations. In 2025, Florida eliminated (230,637) of internal trading (table in thousands).
quotes: Our ready-mix business is fully back-integrated, with access to a strategically-located and reliable supply of primary raw materials, mainly cement and aggregate needed for concrete production.

business_model.claim: Customers are mainly in construction: residential, public infrastructure and large-scale projects. Concrete block is also sold through retail home improvement stores and masonry contractors.
quotes: Our business is largely dependent on demand for residential construction, public spending levels for infrastructure and large-scale projects.

business_model.claim: Sales run on customer Orders that set pre-determined prices for a period. Customers can generally cancel these Orders at any time.
quotes: Orders specify products, contractual terms and conditions, estimated quantities, and pre-determined prices over established time periods.

business_model.claim: Revenue is driven by construction activity, infrastructure development and urbanization. Pricing depends on the balance of supply and demand and on service.
quotes: Revenue is primarily driven by factors such as construction activity levels, infrastructure development and urbanization trends, which influence the demand for our products.
Product pricing is influenced by supply/demand balances, product performance, reliability and service offerings.

business_model.claim: Competition is largely on price, and products are fairly commoditized. This limits pricing power.
quotes: Competition in these segments is based largely on price and on the quality of the material, service provided, logistics and innovative solutions offered.

business_model.claim: Sales are seasonal and depend on weather. Mid-Atlantic sales are typically lower in the first and fourth quarters.

business_model.claim: Operations are geographically concentrated, with about 60% in Florida.

business_model.basis: stated in the P3 results table and narrative

Our Roanoke Plant’s current cement production capacity is 1.5 million tons, and investment is underway with the goal of increasing production capacity to 1.8 million tons by 2030.
